title: JaMoon
tagline: Indexing LIFI swap using The Graph.
description: More importantly, being able to follow top and our fav anon degen in the Crypto space was missing in the current DEXs. So We built more Fun and engaging DEX that help Users to follow their fav degens and get to follow their On-Chain tansactions/moves by Notifying them when their followed degens Swaps any token. This help users keep updated with the top traders, learn and get more into. It's hard to track the tokens from different chain. Jamun solves it buy trackingulti chain token swap data. We're providing Graph ql api on top of LiFI.
how_its_made: We faced several Difficulties while building the platform As we used many protocols hand-on for the first time for example while using The Graph Protocol we faced difficulty in decrypting the JSON, faced difficulty in setting up the Biconomy SDK. Many such difficulties we faced while building JaMoon.
